BookFlip reuses code from the following open-source projects. Per the MIT terms, each copyright
notice and permission notice must accompany the copies shipped with Perch. This file is that
accompanying notice, and it ships inside the deployed build: Vite copies everything under `v2/public/`
into the build output verbatim, so this notice is distributed at `dist/vendor/page-flip/LICENSE.txt`
alongside the page-flip code bundled into the app's JavaScript.

Provenance
----------
- page-flip 2.0.7 — npm package `page-flip`, from github.com/Nodlik/StPageFlip (installed with
  `bun add page-flip`; resolved to 2.0.7, the current published release). Imported in
  BookFlip.tsx as `import { PageFlip, SizeType } from 'page-flip'`. It supplies only the
  page-turn behaviour; the pages it turns are Perch's own `.book-page` elements, and nothing is
  manually vendored - no library code, markup, styles or assets are copied into Perch by hand.
  (The installed package does inject its own CSS at runtime, and that ships as part of the bundled
  JavaScript; this notice covers it.)
- @types/page-flip 2.0.4 — npm package `@types/page-flip` (DefinitelyTyped), installed with
  `bun add -d @types/page-flip`. Type declarations only; no runtime code.
- The page-turn option set and the prev/next control pattern (click an edge, drag, or the
  controls) follow the 2d-book example in HaichaoLihc/create-photo-flipbook-ui, an MIT-licensed
  reference the project chose as its behavioural model, pinned at revision
  15637485d41ec5a96108ba015f584c19b28e28eb (examples/2d-book):
  https://github.com/HaichaoLihc/create-photo-flipbook-ui/tree/15637485d41ec5a96108ba015f584c19b28e28eb/examples/2d-book
  Its page-flip options and control wiring are the reference; no code, assets or styling from that
  repository were copied.
